verdict.rationale: Docs show recurring-transaction insights, consumer spending and loan-payment insights, and a dedicated Transaction Data/Aggregation service (docs-22, docs-7, docs-8), plus a test payroll provider (FinPayroll) used in sandbox testing (docs-33) and credit-decisioning report APIs (docs-13), indicating cash-flow and payroll-adjacent signals are derivable from the data. However, there is no explicit named 'income verification' product or documented payroll-detection algorithm distinct from the generic transaction insights. Missing for 10: a first-party income-verification/payroll-detection product page, independent validation of recurring-stream accuracy, and explicit payroll payer identification beyond the test persona.
